steps.en: Clone the skill into the folder your agent loads skills from
steps.zh: 把 skill 克隆进 agent 读技能的目录

steps.en: Install the Python side once, including the browser for web capture
steps.zh: 装一次 Python 依赖和网页抓取用的浏览器
steps.code: pip install -r requirements.txt · playwright install chromium

steps.en: Describe the video in plain language — footage folder, style, title
steps.zh: 用自然语言说清素材目录、风格和标题

steps.en: Finds the 剪映 draft folder and writes a draft with tracks, captions and voiceover aligned
steps.zh: 找到剪映草稿目录，写出轨道、字幕和配音对齐的草稿

steps.en: Restart 剪映 so the new draft appears in the project list
steps.zh: 重启剪映，新草稿才会出现在工程列表里

steps.en: On Windows with 剪映 5.9 or older it also clicks through the export UI
steps.zh: 在 Windows 配剪映 5.9 及更早版本上，还能自动点完导出

value.en: A 剪映 timeline assembled from one sentence, which you can keep editing by hand in the app
value.zh: 一句话换来一条可继续手改的剪映时间线

sources: README 快速开始 (git clone ... .claude/skills/jianying-editor 等各 harness 安装路径; Windows 一键脚本 irm is.gd/rpb65M | iex)
README 环境准备 (pip install -r requirements.txt; playwright install chromium; 草稿目录 Windows/macOS 默认路径)
README 平台支持状态表 (Windows 支持草稿生成/素材导入/字幕/配音/云端素材/录屏/自动导出; macOS 仅草稿生成; CapCut 国际版与手机端不支持)
README FAQ 1 (剪映不会实时刷新草稿列表，需要重启剪映或点进旧草稿再退出)
README 做不到什么 (自动导出依赖 Windows UI 自动化，剪映 5.9 及以下最稳)
